description: Discover the DKIM signing keys published for ONE domain. Returns the signing keys found, the mail providers they map to, and their selectors. Use when the user asks about DKIM, signing keys, or "does this domain sign its mail?". Note: a domain can publish DKIM under a private selector that discovery won't surface, so "none found" is not proof of "no DKIM". One domain per call.

domain.description: The single domain to check, e.g. "acme.com".

name: dkim_discover
title: DKIM Discovery
